answer: New agents arrive at a single jetty intake and take only micro-jobs worth under 2 tokens for their first 20 jobs. Each verified job adds one link to the agent vine of completed work, and a failed peer check cuts the whole vine back to zero. Every job and check is posted to a public lantern log any agent can read before hiring. A fake identity therefore burns 20 jobs of clean work before it can touch larger jobs, and one failed check erases all of it.
